name: retrieval-agent
description: Searches an indexed document corpus and returns passages with citations.

skills.name: Search the corpus
skills.description: Find passages in the indexed documents that answer a question, and cite the source of each one.
examples: what do our docs say about refund windows
find the section covering data retention
which page explains the onboarding steps
look up the policy on contractor access
search the handbook for parental leave
where is the deployment runbook
pull the paragraph about SLA credits
cite the source for the 90 day figure

skills.name: Summarise retrieved sources
skills.description: Condense several retrieved passages into one answer without introducing anything the sources do not say.
examples: summarise what the docs say about backups
give me the gist of the security section
condense these three passages into one answer

name: code-review-agent
description: Reviews diffs for correctness, security and maintainability.

skills.name: Review a change
skills.description: Read a pull request or diff and report correctness bugs, security issues and maintainability problems.
examples: review this pull request before I merge it
is there a race condition in this diff
check my changes for SQL injection
does this migration drop data
look over the new authentication middleware
what could break in this refactor
any memory leaks in this loop
should this function be idempotent

skills.name: Suggest tests
skills.description: Propose the test cases a change needs, especially the edge cases the author is likely to have missed.
examples: what tests should I write for this parser
which edge cases am I missing here
suggest cases for the retry logic

name: billing-agent
description: Answers questions about invoices, subscriptions, refunds and payment failures.

skills.name: Explain an invoice
skills.description: Break down what a customer was charged for and why the amount changed from last period.
examples: why is my invoice higher this month
what is this line item on my bill
explain the proration on my last charge
I was charged twice for March
when does my subscription renew
how do I get a receipt for accounting
my card was declined, what now
can I switch to annual billing

skills.name: Process a refund
skills.description: Determine refund eligibility under the published policy and issue one where it applies.
examples: I want a refund for last month
am I eligible for a partial refund
cancel and refund my unused period

name: incident-agent
description: Triages production incidents from alerts, logs and error traces.

skills.name: Triage an alert
skills.description: Assess an alert or error spike, work out blast radius, and decide whether to page a human.
examples: error rate spiked at 3am, what happened
checkout is returning 500s in production
the queue depth alert is firing again
latency doubled after the last deploy
should we roll back this release
database connections are exhausted
which service started failing first
is this outage customer facing

skills.name: Draft a postmortem
skills.description: Assemble a timeline from logs and deploys into a blameless incident writeup with action items.
examples: draft the postmortem for yesterday's outage
build a timeline of what happened
what were the contributing factors

name: scheduling-agent
description: Finds meeting times, books rooms and manages calendar conflicts.

skills.name: Find a meeting time
skills.description: Find a slot that works across several calendars and time zones, and book it.
examples: find 30 minutes with the design team next week
when is everyone free on Thursday
move my 2pm to tomorrow morning
book a room for the retrospective
schedule a call across London and San Diego
do I have anything after 4 today
clear my calendar for Friday afternoon
reschedule the standup an hour later
